title: Effectivity and coherent counits of the native support limit
statement: Let $\ell,E,D,X,Y,f,c,S,K$ satisfy the same single-coefficient hypotheses as [lem-pur-compact-support-native-realization]. Let $L=\operatorname{scalarSupport}_{E,c,S}(K)$, the total limit of [def-pur-compact-support-scalar-limit-maps]. Then $L$ is intrinsically derived complete. For all $n\le m$, the actual native projection adjuncts satisfy $\epsilon_m\tau_{mn}=d_{mn}\operatorname{Res}_{mn}(\epsilon_n)$, where $\tau$ is coefficientSequenceDerivedTransition and $d$ is normalizedDVRReductionTransition of [lem-coef-normalized-dvr-effectivity]. Every scalarSupportCounit to the finite compact-support presentation is an isomorphism. All maps are the adjoints of the prescribed projections, not independently chosen finite isomorphisms.

proof.text: Construct the normalized DVR tower using the native evaluations and transitions and their exact completed restriction. Native finite-action normalization supplies its normalization.

The actual completed tower has the canonical Roos triangle with coefficientConstantTowerProjection. Apply normalizedDVRTower_effectivity. Pi.lift projection identities identify its counit with scalarSupportNativeCounit, so obtain every quotient cocycle and native counit isomorphism. Convert legacy completeness to intrinsic completeness.
Adjunction uniqueness expresses scalarSupportCounit as finiteReductionIso followed by the native counit and scalarSupportEvaluation. All three factors are isomorphisms.

theorem compactSupport_native_effectivity
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c : Compactification f) (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E X)
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X)) (hK : sfIntegralConstructible l E X K) :
    IsSfDerivedComplete l E Y ((scalarSupport l E c S).obj K) ∧
    (∀ (m n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
      scalarSupportNativeCounit l E c S m K ≫
          (coefficientSequenceDerivedTransition l E Y h).app
            ((scalarSupportNative l E c S).obj K) =
        normalizedDVRReductionTransition l E Y D hl h ((scalarSupport l E c S).obj K) ≫
          (normalizedDVRRes l E Y h).map (scalarSupportNativeCounit l E c S n K)) ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (scalarSupportCounit l E c S n K)
